limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter enable but also removed the downstream-ready guard, so the first accepted byte of a group replaces the previous sum when ready_b is low instead of being added to it as in the reference.
The scoreboard assumed a fresh sum for every group regardless of ready_b, so the backpressure tests validated the extra change rather than detecting it.
